we have shown that the small-molecule inducer of macroautophagy (autophagy) and lysosomal biogenesis, trehalose, can be used as a therapeutic for the neuropathic lysosomal storage disorder, mucopolysacaridoses type IIIB.

the autophagy inducer trehalose is effective in treating the neurologic phenotype of a lysosomal storage disease, and that autophagy induction may be an effective therapeutic approach to treat other neuropathic lysosomal diseases.
